mapper.select: SELECT r.reservation_id, r.user_id, r.salon_id, r.stylist_id, r.service_id, r.reservation_time, r.status, s.salon_name AS salon_name, p.transaction_id, p.payment_method, p.amount, se.service_name AS service_name, p.original_amount, p.coupon_discount, p.point_used, p.pg_provider FROM Reservations r JOIN Salons s ON s.salon_id = r.salon_id JOIN Services se ON se.service_id = r.service_id LEFT JOIN Payments p ON p.reservation_id = r.reservation_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.reservation_time DESC

FROM Reservations r JOIN Users u ON u.user_id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN Stylists st ON st.stylist_id = r.stylist_id JOIN Services se ON se.service_id = r.service_id LEFT JOIN Payments p ON p.reservation_id = r.reservation_id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Reservations (user_id, salon_id, stylist_id, service_id, reservation_time, status) SELECT #{userId}, #{salonId}, #{stylistId}, #{serviceId}, #{reservationTime}, 'pending' FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT stylist_id, reservation_time, status, created_at FROM Reservations) r WHERE r.stylist_id = #{stylistId} AND r.reservation_time = #{reservationTime} AND (r.status IN ('confirmed', 'completed') OR (r.status = 'pending' AND r.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)) )
mapper.select: SELECT r.reservation_id, r.user_id, r.salon_id, r.stylist_id, r.service_id, r.reservation_time, r.status, s.salon_name AS salon_name, se.service_name AS service_name, p.amount AS amount, p.transaction_id, p.payment_method, p.original_amount, p.coupon_discount, p.point_used, p.pg_provider FROM Reservations r JOIN Salons s ON s.salon_id = r.salon_id JOIN Services se ON se.service_id = r.service_id LEFT JOIN Payments p ON p.reservation_id = r.reservation_id WHERE r.reservation_id = #{reservationId}

SELECT r.reservation_id, r.user_id, r.salon_id, r.stylist_id, r.service_id, r.reservation_time, r.status, p.pg_provider FROM Reservations r LEFT JOIN Payments p ON p.reservation_id = r.reservation_id WHERE r.stylist_id = #{stylistId} AND r.reservation_time = #{reservationTime} AND r.status = 'pending' AND r.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE LIMIT 1
